The MB Confession of Faith

18 Articles

From God's nature to Christ's final triumph, explore the foundational truths that guide Mennonite Brethren faith and practice.

Biblical Foundation

Rooted in Scripture, each article reflects the authority of God's Word and the witness of the Holy Spirit through the ages.

Living Faith

A confession meant to be lived, calling believers to discipleship, community, and witness in the way of Christ.

Articles of Faith

1. God 2. Revelation of God 3. Creation and Humanity 4. Sin and Evil 5. Salvation 6. Nature of the Church 7. Mission of the Church 8. Christian Baptism 9. Lord's Supper 10. Discipleship 11. Marriage, Singleness, and Family 12. Society and State 13. Love and Nonresistance 14. The Sanctity of Human Life 15. Stewardship 16. The Lord's Day, Work and Rest 17. Christianity and Other Faiths 18. Christ's Final Triumph
